source_format_note: Editable PNG sources for the decoded 2bpp tile/map bytes. Each resource is a lossless PNG: tilesets are 4-colour indexed images (8x8 pixels per tile, row-major), tilemaps are 32x32 8-bit grayscale images whose pixel value is the raw tile index. 00_Tools/build.py derives the game bytes from these PNGs and verifies the pinned decoded/packed SHA-256 values. All HAL streams, including earlier unreferenced allocations, are retained for exact published SHA-256. This is a localization release-source snapshot, not a complete game disassembly.
editing_note: Edit 03_Image/graphics/*.png tile atlases without changing tile counts or image dimensions, or edit the readable full-page PNGs in 03_Image/pages/ and run 00_Tools/pages.py retile; then run 00_Tools/repack.py with a new --version. Avoid anti-aliasing, transparency and off-palette colours. Existing pointers are preserved; a grown resource is relocated into free expanded-ROM space and its loader patches are rewritten. Translation JSON and assets/ PNGs are reference material only.

page_note: 03_Image/pages/<id>.png are the 21 bundle pages (tiles+map in one resource). The other 27 pages (23 tilemap + 4 sheet) are stored as baseline+overlay edits under 03_Image/edits/<id>.json with a <id>_cells.png overlay atlas: the baseline is rebuilt from the user-provided Rev1 ROM, so only changed 8x8 cells are tracked. Run 00_Tools/page_edits.py render to rebuild them into build/pages/; 00_Tools/pages.py render checks both storage modes. Bundle cells that reference original-ROM tiles are drawn as a placeholder and stay read-only.
